detail: The application started after the MySQL health check passed but the first database connection was refused. Starting the application again after database startup succeeded.

The release used the generic Infinity document mapping for a Memory store. Native message insertion failed because valid_at and message_id were not columns in that store. Knowledge ingestion succeeded. Preserve this as a release integration failure, not an Infinity vector-quality result.
The release Compose file includes OpenSearch 2.19.1, but the Go migration/runtime rejected DOC_ENGINE=opensearch as not implemented. No model call was needed to identify the rejection.
The official default Elasticsearch 8.11.3 supports both tested native paths. Its knowledge and Memory mappings both use dense_vector dimensions=4096. No product source patch was applied.
The version endpoint was available before the admin/license heartbeat. The trial now waits for an authenticated native Memory list request before ingestion or restart acceptance.

The correct release Docker tag is v0.5.0. The first server configuration was rejected because dev authentication cannot bind to 0.0.0.0. The trial enabled native API-key authentication, created an account and scoped admin user, and used the issued user key for data operations.
Native namespace initialization queued directory-description embeddings before the first resource completed. Preserve cold setup time separately; all provider calls remained within the budget.
The fixed historical input timestamp is passed into the documented created_at field. The initial calibration attempt used import time and remains preserved. No formal answer was rerun.
